description: This Dart file defines the 'RecipeDetailScreen' widget for a Flutter app, responsible for displaying detailed information about a specific recipe, including image, ingredients, directions, and related metadata.

classes.name: RecipeDetailScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays detailed information about a specific recipe, including an image, metadata, ingredients, and steps.

classes.name: _RecipeMeta
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays metadata of the recipe such as duration, servings, and tags.

classes.name: _MetaChip
classes.description: A widget that displays an icon with a label inside a chip, used for displaying metadata like duration and servings.

classes.name: _Section
classes.description: A widget that provides a titled section with content, used for ingredients and directions.

classes.name: _BulletedList
classes.description: A widget that displays a list of ingredients with bullet points.

classes.name: _NumberedList
classes.description: A widget that displays a list of steps with numbered indicators.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the recipe detail screen based on the provided context.
